name: Tofu, greens & cashew stir-fry
assumptions: Yield estimated at 2 servings based on total ingredient quantities (e.g. 300g tofu, 225g broccoli, 140g soya beans) typical for 2 adult portions in a stir-fry.
Hoisin sauce assumed to contain wheat and soy (common in commercial versions) leading to null for gluten-free and true for soy allergen.
Soy sauce assumed to contain wheat (common unless specified otherwise) leading to null for gluten-free.
Cashew nuts trigger tree nuts allergen as true.
No explicit dairy, eggs, fish, shellfish, peanuts, or sesame in listed ingredients.
Vegan/vegetarian true as all ingredients (tofu, vegetables, sauces, nuts) are plant-based with no meat/dairy/eggs.
Pescatarian true due to absence of meat but presence of fish allergen as null (no fish present).
Preparation time estimated at 15 minutes: ~5 min for broccoli, ~1 min for garlic/chilli, ~2-3 min stir-fry, plus minimal additional time implied; no separate prep step detailed.
instructions:
step 1
Heat the oil in a non-stick wok. Add the broccoli, then fry on a high heat for 5 mins or until just tender, adding a little water if it begins to catch. Add the garlic and chilli, fry for 1 min, then toss through the spring onions, soya beans, pak choi and tofu. Stir-fry for 2-3 mins. Add the hoisin, soy and nuts to warm through.

ingredients.name: Vegetable Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbsp vegetable oil is 14g; 100% fat assumed for typical neutral oil.

ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium head of broccoli estimated at 225g edible raw weight based on typical recipe usage.

ingredients.assumptions: 4 cloves garlic total ~12g; standard raw garlic nutrient profile.

ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium red chilli ~30g whole (edible portion after slicing).

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 1 bunch spring onions estimated at 100g edible raw weight.

ingredients.assumptions: Soya beans (edamame) given as 140g; typical values for cooked/frozen.

ingredients.assumptions: Marinated tofu given as 300g; typical values for firm marinated tofu.

ingredients.assumptions: Cashew nuts given as 25g; standard roasted/salted profile.
